question.text: The portfolio manager must furnish the client report agreed in the contract at intervals not exceeding:

explanation.text: The Logic: Client reports must be furnished periodically as agreed in the contract, but at intervals not exceeding three months — i.e., at least quarterly. The Trap: Monthly may be done as a courtesy; annually and never both breach the three-month outer limit. Note: The cited source lists portfolio composition/value, transactions, beneficial interests, expenses, risks, defaults and distributor commission details as part of the periodic client report.
